name: Elvis's Birthday
description: Johnny in pompadour wig and rhinestone collar, tiny guitar leaned against the palm.

name: MLK Jr. Day
description: Johnny stands at attention beside a small podium with a paper banner reading I HAVE A DREAM.

name: Groundhog Day
description: A groundhog pops out of a sand-burrow casting a long shadow; Johnny squints at it skeptically.

name: Valentine's Day
description: Heart carved into the palm trunk, rose in Johnny's teeth, pink heart-shaped clouds.

name: Super Bowl Sunday
description: Johnny in face paint with foam finger; football tee'd up in the sand, tiny goalposts of driftwood.

name: Presidents' Day
description: Johnny in tricorn hat saluting a tiny stars-and-stripes; cherry tree sapling next to the palm.

name: Mardi Gras
description: Johnny in feathered mask and beads; coconut maracas; jazz notes drifting on the breeze.

name: Pi Day
description: A pie cooling on a rock, pi symbol drawn in the sand, Johnny in nerd glasses with a slide rule.

name: First Day of Spring
description: Cherry blossoms blooming on the palm, butterflies, Johnny stretching in the sun.

name: April Fool's Day
description: Whoopee cushion under Johnny's hammock; the sun is wearing a clown nose; palm leaves are upside-down.

name: Easter
description: Pastel eggs hidden in the sand, bunny ears on Johnny, basket woven from palm fronds.

name: Earth Day
description: Johnny planting a sapling, a globe-shaped buoy washed ashore, recycling bin made from a barrel.

name: Star Wars Day
description: Johnny in brown Jedi robe wielding a glowing palm-frond lightsaber; tiny droid silhouette in the surf.

name: Cinco de Mayo
description: Sombrero on Johnny, papel picado bunting between palms, maraca-coconut in hand.

name: Mother's Day
description: Bouquet of tropical flowers in a coconut vase; MOM drawn large in the sand with shells.

name: Memorial Day
description: Small American flag at half-staff in the sand; Johnny removes his hat in salute.

name: Father's Day
description: #1 DAD sandcastle, Johnny in a Worlds Best Castaway tie, tiny grill smoking on a rock.

name: First Day of Summer
description: Sun is huge and beaming; Johnny in shades, beach umbrella stuck in the sand, popsicle in hand.

name: Pride Day
description: Rainbow flag fashioned from palm fronds, Johnny with rainbow lei, prismatic surf foam.

name: Independence Day
description: Fireworks bursting over the ocean, Johnny in Uncle Sam hat, sparkler in hand, flag planted in sand.

name: Moon Landing Day
description: A toy rocket on the beach, footprints leading to the surf, the moon enormous and cratered overhead.

name: National Watermelon Day
description: Slice of watermelon as Johnny's hat; rinds scattered, seeds being spit at a crab.

name: Left-Handers Day
description: Johnny waves with his left hand; everything on the island is mirrored - palm leans left, sun on the left.

name: Hawaii Statehood Day
description: Hula skirt on Johnny, tiki torches lit, ukulele leaning on the message-bottle.

name: Labor Day
description: Johnny in hardhat and tool-belt; a half-built tiki hut and a GONE FISHIN sign on the palm.

name: Talk Like a Pirate Day
description: Eyepatch and tricorn on Johnny, jolly roger flag from the palm, parrot perched on shoulder.

name: First Day of Autumn
description: Palm leaves tinged orange and red, a few drifting down; Johnny in a flannel shirt over his rags.

name: Columbus / Indigenous Peoples' Day
description: A tiny galleon on the horizon; Johnny holds a hand-drawn map and looks confused.

name: Election Day
description: I VOTED sticker on Johnny's chest, ballot box made from a crate, tiny donkey and elephant in surf.

name: Veterans Day
description: Johnny in dress-uniform cap saluting; a wreath of palm leaves leans against the trunk.

name: Thanksgiving
description: A small cooked turkey on a banana-leaf platter, pilgrim hat on Johnny, cornucopia spilling tropical fruit.
